content: Similar to BIBREF21 khot2017answering, we use ElasticSearch to retrieve facts from open KBs. We remove stop words from tokens of each argument and predicate in a document KB and regard the remained words as ElasticSearch queries. We set different search option for arguments and predicates, namely setting arguments as the dominant searchable fields for argument queries and setting predicates as the dominant searchable fields for predicate queries. We save the top 10 hints and selectively use them in the experiment.
